output.summary: The decline is mostly a venue and access shock, not a programming failure. The move to Brightwater cut seats 40% and added transit and parking barriers. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first season, and low-attendance subscribers stopped renewing. The cathedral downtown dates sold 1,520 tickets against 1,027 at Brightwater. Per-concert comparisons show no penalty for post-1945 works. Core attenders renew at a steady 85%. Peers lost a similar share of revenue, so part of the decline is regional. Marketing is untested because nothing is tracked. Non-renewal on revenue grounds would be wrong and would forfeit $400k a year in grant money. Recommend a segmented analysis, the cathedral dates and a shuttle pilot.
